cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: Licenses renew December 31 of odd-numbered years; the reporting period is the two calendar years before.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: Up to 15 extra non-technical credits from the previous reporting period count toward the 80 (not toward technical or yearly minimums).

requirements.label: Technical fields
requirements.note: At least half of the credits in technical fields: accounting, auditing, business law, economics, finance, IT, management services, regulatory ethics, specialized knowledge, statistics, taxes.

requirements.label: Georgia-specific ethics
requirements.note: 1 of the 4 ethics credits must cover the laws, rules and policies of the Georgia Board. We count courses with "Georgia" and "ethics" or "rules" in the title.

byIssueYearInPeriod.note: Licensed in the first year of this period: 40 credits (at least 20 in the second year), including the 4 ethics credits.
Licensed in the second year of this period: no CPE is due for your first renewal.

newLicensee.note: Not required in the year you were licensed.

licenseDateHint: Georgia licenses renew December 31 of odd-numbered years (e.g. 12/31/2027). Licensees 70 or older are exempt.
issueDateHint: If you were licensed during this period, your first-renewal requirement is reduced or waived.
limitsNotTracked: Instruction, authorship and technical-reviewer credit: max 50% each.
recordRetention: Keep documentation for 5 years after each program.
toVerify: Rule 20-11 read from the Board's posted revised rule (2024) — effective date not shown on the document; GSCPA says the new rules apply from January 1, 2024.
New licensees licensed in year 1: technical requirement set to 20 (50% of 40).
Georgia-specific ethics course matched by title; both Regulatory and Behavioral Ethics count toward the 4 ethics credits.
